asymmetry_reach.note: the baryon asymmetry is fixed at sphaleron freeze-out (T~130 GeV); the larger lepton asymmetry builds up later (T down to ~100 MeV), unwashed by sphalerons, so Delta L/s ~ 1e6 x Y_B is consistent — both from N_{2,3}
asymmetry_reach.requires: near-degenerate N_{2,3} (resonant CP enhancement) + O(1) CP phases
asymmetry_reach.degeneracy_status: free parameter (the known nuMSM resonance corner) — not derived

verdict: YES — the model's intrinsic lepton-number violation (F47, derived) plus 3-generation CP violation (F53/F75, available: 1 Dirac + 2 Majorana phases) plus feeble-coupling out-of-equilibrium dynamics meet ALL three Sakharov conditions, and the SU(2)_L sphalerons convert L to B. So the SAME sterile sector (the two heavy N_{2,3} of the F201 texture) can source BOTH the baryon asymmetry and the ~1e6x-larger late lepton asymmetry resonant keV-DM production needs (the nuMSM unification). Not derived: the CP-phase magnitudes and the N_{2,3} degeneracy that set the asymmetry's SIZE — the same free corner the nuMSM uses, inherited not solved.
